derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 0, SignalBar, 3) → Value[0]=current bar, Value[1]=previous bar, Value[2]=two bars ago

derived_values.name: XMA rising condition
derived_values.formula: Value[1] < Value[2] (XMA was rising on previous bar)

derived_values.name: XMA falling condition

other_exits: Long position closed when XMA falling condition detected (Value[1] > Value[2]) and BuyPosClose=true
Short position closed when XMA rising condition detected (Value[1] < Value[2]) and SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM=-0.1 means negative values are treated as fixed lot size (0.1 lots), positive values are deposit share fraction

custom_logic_notes: The 3rd Generation XMA indicator is a double-smoothed moving average using configurable smoothing methods (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA). It requires SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which contains the CXMA class with GetStartBars() and the full smoothing algorithm implementations. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with global variable management and signal time tracking. Entry logic: long when XMA was rising (Value[1]<Value[2]) and current bar continues rise (Value[0]>Value[1]); short when XMA was falling (Value[1]>Value[2]) and current bar continues fall (Value[0]<Value[1]). SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar (shift=1). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates allowing independent control of entry and exit permissions.
external_dependencies: SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - Contains CXMA class with 10 smoothing method implementations (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA)
TradeAlgorithms.mqh - Contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar
3rdGenXMA custom indicator - The actual indicator file loaded via iCustom
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol H4 730 days (default H4 timeframe, symbol from chart)
python_conversion_notes: The 3rdGenXMA indicator is a double-smoothed moving average: first smooth with period 2*XLength, then smooth the result with period XLength, both using the same XMA_Method. The third generation aspect adds a correction term. For Python conversion: (1) Implement the selected smoothing method (default EMA with period 50) - can use pandas EWM for EMA; (2) Compute first smooth on price with period 100 (2*50), then second smooth on result with period 50; (3) The signal logic is straightforward: compare 3 consecutive XMA values. Entry on next bar open after signal. The SignalBar=1 offset means using previous bar's values for signal generation. Position sizing with negative MM value means fixed lot size of 0.1. StopLoss=1000 points, TakeProfit=2000 points. Signal reversal closes existing position before opening opposite.
